text:
The plate looks like a side plate of about 22 cm. It holds 3-4 strips of dark, glazed bacon, possibly candied, and a small portion of broccoli.

Bacon: each strip is long, about 18 cm, and these look thick and cooked down. Four strips at roughly 10 g each come to about 40 g. At about 5 kcal/g for cooked bacon, plus a glaze, that is about 200 kcal.

Broccoli: about 60 g at 0.35 kcal/g is about 20 kcal, and some oil or butter may add around 20 kcal more.

Total: about 100 g of food and about 240 kcal.
